# PWON.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp312.0 against Rp258.0 (expected total return 25.6%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: property_nav_discount_narrowing · method card: per fund record routing for Property developers.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The FY2026E presales decline of -19% (1,300 -> 1,053) is justified by 'the 2026 marketing-sales target of Rp1.5 trn [S6]', but S6 contains no such figure (it reports the Rp13/Rp626bn dividend and Q1-2026 results) and, if
- The scenario engine is vacuous on the operating drivers. RNAV uses no presales; the P/E metric is LTM np_parent Rp2,346.1bn (FY2025A) and the P/BV metric is 1H26 book Rp22,843.9bn, both fixed across scenarios. Arithmetic
- The RNAV deducts the full USD notes (debt Rp5,937.5bn = US$333.4m x ~17,810) but excludes the matching 'Other Financial Asset USD' of Rp5,667bn [S9 p.28]. m_rnav never reads mkt.bridge, and m_multiple applies the bridge 

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
